_provenance: Hand-constructed, NOT fetched from Google. Shape matches the documented Distance Matrix API response schema (https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/distance-matrix/distance-matrix as of 2026; top-level status/origin_addresses/destination_addresses/rows[].elements[]{status,duration{value,text},distance{value,text}}). Values are plausible but invented: two origins (a London-ish and a Manchester-ish point) against two destinations (a Leeds-ish point and an unreachable island), used by server/tests/test_distances.py to exercise a 2x2 grid without any network access. Written for the M3 distance-service pre-build (plan/features/distances/).
